chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
He is not from us who abandons his worldly life for his Hereafter, nor his Hereafter for his worldly life.

key_terms.دُنْيَاهُ: his worldly life and material affairs
key_terms.لَيْسَ مِنَّا: is not of our way or path
key_terms.لِآخِرَتِهِ: for the sake of his Hereafter

ai.seo_question: Does Islam teach abandoning worldly life for the sake of the Hereafter?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام teaches that a believer should not neglect either worldly responsibilities or preparation for the Hereafter. The hadith emphasizes balance, rejecting an approach that sacrifices one realm entirely for the other.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: He is not from us who abandons his worldly life for his Hereafter, nor his Hereafter for his worldly life."
